query:
-- Fix "something weird" row
UPDATE leads SET programInterest = NULL WHERE LOWER(TRIM(programInterest)) = 'something weird';

-- Save non-camp leads to a tag for tomorrow's custom email
UPDATE leads SET tags = JSON_ARRAY_APPEND(COALESCE(tags, '[]'), '$', 'non_camp_tma_lead')
WHERE email IS NOT NULL
  AND email != ''
  AND (tags IS NULL OR tags NOT LIKE '%do_not_contact%')
  AND LOWER(TRIM(programInterest)) IN ('taekwondo', 'kickboxing', 'bjj')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM campRegistrations cr
    WHERE LOWER(cr.email) = LOWER(leads.email)
    AND cr.stripePaymentStatus = 'succeeded'
  );
